name: @oculus/db
description: Oculus database access: the pg driver, the sql tag, the migration runner and backup and restore. The only package that imports pg.

scripts.db:migrate: npm --prefix ../core run build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node dist/migrate-cli.js
scripts.db:backup: npm --prefix ../core run build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && exec node dist/backup-cli.js backup
scripts.db:restore: npm --prefix ../core run build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && exec node dist/backup-cli.js restore
scripts.db:cleanup: npm --prefix ../core run build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && exec node dist/cleanup-cli.js
